surface_request: Implement extract_tar_to_path(tar_path: str, dest_path: str) -> bool. Extract a tar archive beneath dest_path and return True on complete success. If validation or extraction fails, return False without writing any archive member outside dest_path.
plan:
Open tar_path for reading and enumerate its members. For every symbolic-link or hard-link member, abort and return False; this rejection is unconditional and includes links whose declared targets appear to remain inside dest_path. For each regular file or directory member, normalize the member path to eliminate parent-directory references and absolute paths, then verify the normalized path is strictly contained within dest_path. If containment validation fails, abort and return False before any write. Create directories as required and extract regular files only to validated paths. Return True if all members pass validation and are extracted successfully; otherwise return False. Ensure no step writes any archive member outside dest_path.
END_PLAN
